# Chapter name mapping
ch_names <- c(
  "Ch. 1" = "Simple Regression",
  "Ch. 2" = "Gauss-Markov & BLUE",
  "Ch. 3" = "Estimation in R",
  "Ch. 4" = "Matrix Algebra",
  "Ch. 5" = "Inference & Variables",
  "Ch. 6" = "Heteroskedasticity & WLS"
)

# Sort alphabetically
index_entries <- index_entries[order(index_entries$Term), ]

# Build the index with letter headings
current_letter <- ""
for (i in seq_len(nrow(index_entries))) {
  first_letter <- toupper(substr(index_entries$Term[i], 1, 1))
  if (first_letter != current_letter) {
    current_letter <- first_letter
    cat(paste0("\n### ", current_letter, "\n\n"))
  }
  cat(paste0("**", index_entries$Term[i], "**",
             " — ", index_entries$Chapter[i],
             ": *", index_entries$Section[i], "*\n\n"))
}
